tile.heading: Patient call
tile.degraded: Realtime video unavailable; the talking head follows the voice audio.
tile.noVoice: No voice provider is enabled. Replies are shown as text.
tile.voiceOff: Voice is off. Turn it on to hear the patient.

captions.label: Live captions
captions.empty: Captions appear as the patient speaks.

tile.endedNote: The patient is still here. Rejoin to continue the voice call; typing always works.

liveVideo.preparing: Preparing the patient's face for live video
liveVideo.workerStarting: Live video starts when the GPU worker is up; showing the animated portrait
liveVideo.unavailable: Live video unavailable; showing the animated portrait
